app.name: Khiye
app.tagline: Learn by doing, not by reading.

home.title: Build it yourself. See it live.
home.lede: Mongolian students build a real online store, Shop.mn, from scratch — writing every line themselves and seeing the result instantly.
home.f1Body: Not toy exercises — you write the Shop.mn store line by line, yourself.
home.f2Body: Every line you write renders instantly in the live preview beside it.
home.f3Body: Each task is really run and checked on a server — never guessed at.
home.f4Body: Every concept comes with a diagram and an everyday analogy — clear even for a beginner.
home.f5Body: No copy-paste. You type every line and actually learn it.
home.f6Body: Instructions, explanations and error messages are all in Mongolian.
home.journeyTitle: From your first '<h1>' to a full app
home.journeyLede: Each lesson builds on the last, step by step, until it becomes a real store.
home.closeBody: The first lesson takes just minutes. Start now.
home.showcaseTitle: A whole stack, line by line
home.showcaseLede: From HTML to shipping on a server — the milestones on the way to building Shop.mn.

showcaseSlides.title: HTML — raise your first page.
showcaseSlides.desc: Headings, buttons, images. You assemble the first structure the browser shows.

showcaseSlides.title: CSS — make the store look good.
showcaseSlides.desc: Colour, spacing, grid. Bare text starts to look like a real shop.

showcaseSlides.title: JavaScript — bring it to life.
showcaseSlides.desc: A click adds to the cart. The page starts to respond to you.

showcaseSlides.title: React — reusable components.
showcaseSlides.desc: Write a piece once and reuse it everywhere. State and effects.

showcaseSlides.title: A server and a database.
showcaseSlides.desc: APIs and a database. Orders are really saved and really checked.

showcaseSlides.title: Ship it — Shop.mn goes live.
showcaseSlides.desc: Put the app you built on the internet for others to use.
